records.subject: Confirming cancellation for Lantern Works
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Cancellation confirmed. If there's anything we could've done differently, I'd appreciate hearing it -- always trying to get better.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Lantern Works
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no tickets, and no customer reply to welcome email [email:59ea612e]; customer no-showed the kickoff [calendar:f0b4c786]. Zero engagement signals make unaided activation in the remaining 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Lantern Works started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Sorry we missed each other last week — happy to find a time that works better.

Most teams get going by setting up their first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready for your team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk you through your first project and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
